name: Option-O Lagom P64
details: Single-dose electric grinder with 64 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–1.3, moka pot 1.2–4.1, AeroPress 0.8–7.1, V60 1.6–4.5, filter coffee machine 0.6–6.5, French press 4.5–10, cold brew 5.6–10; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
